alerts.title: Byrd Visitor Center Closed for the Season
alerts.description: Due to poor weather conditions along Skyline Drive, Byrd Visitor Center is closing for the season ahead of schedule. Once Skyline Drive reopens, The Dicky Ridge Visitor Center will be open for the winter (weather permitting) 9am to 4:30pm, Friday through Tuesday (closed Wednesday and Thursday).

alerts.title: Skyline Drive Road Closure
alerts.description: Date Posted: 11/26/2026 Mile post 0 to 5 of Skyline Drive, including the Dicky Ridge Visitor Center is now open. The rest of Skyline drive remains closed from Mile post 5, to Rockfish Gap Entrance Station (milepost 105) due to severe inclement weather and hazardous driving conditions.

alerts.title: Active Closure
alerts.description: Due to recent wildlife interactions and out of an abundance of caution, the Naked Creek backcountry zone is closed to all recreation until further notice.

alerts.title: Infrastructure Improvements to Old Rag Trailhead
alerts.description: On May 4, Shenandoah National Park began infrastructure enhancements at the Old Rag Trailhead main parking lot. We expect to complete work by early 2027. Until then, the main parking lot is closed to all vehicle and pedestrian traffic. Visitors can access Old Rag Trailhead via existing overflow parking lots. Day-use tickets are still required from March 1 through November 30 in addition to a park entrance fee.

alerts.title: Parking at Boundary Access Areas
alerts.description: Visitors are reminded to park in designated parking areas when accessing the park via boundary trailheads. Parking in unauthorized locations may result in your vehicle being towed at the owner's expense. Park on the right side of the road approaching Thompson Hollow. Parking is authorized up to the "No Parking" sign before a private driveway.

alerts.title: Get Skyline Drive Status Updates
alerts.description: Sign up for Shenandoah Alerts by texting SHENALERTS to 888777. Any time there are closures, re-openings, or other important safety-related alerts, subscribers will receive a notification via text. You may unsubscribe at any time.

alerts.title: Ticket Required to Hike Old Rag
alerts.description: March 1 - November 30 those wishing to hike Old Rag are required to obtain a day-use ticket before arriving.

alerts.title: Shenandoah National Park Moved to Fully Cashless Fee Collection
alerts.description: On July 1, 2025, the park transitioned to a fully cashless system at our fee entrance stations. Only credit cards, debit cards, or mobile payments will be accepted.
